findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0339: SQL Injection in Content Providers
findings.explanation:
For the notes_v2 URI, the exported CardContentProvider passes the caller's raw selection and sort order straight into an SQL string over the notes table. Access is gated only by a dangerous-level permission that users can grant to any app.
AnkiDroid/src/main/java/com/ichi2/anki/provider/CardContentProvider.kt:290: Caller-controlled selection and order concatenated into the SQL query without sanitization.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0393: Use of Unverified App Links
findings.explanation:
IntentHandler declares a VIEW+BROWSABLE intent-filter with http/https data schemes (host=*, for .apkg/.colpkg/.csv/.tsv/.txt) without android:autoVerify="true".
AnkiDroid/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:136: http deep link in an intent-filter with no autoVerify.
AnkiDroid/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:142: https deep link in the same unverified intent-filter.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0372: Implicit Intents Used for Internal App Communication
findings.explanation:
SdCardReceiver sends app-internal broadcasts (com.ichi2.anki.action.MEDIA_EJECT / MEDIA_MOUNT) as implicit intents with no package or permission, so any app can register a receiver for them.
AnkiDroid/src/main/java/com/ichi2/anki/receiver/SdCardReceiver.kt:24: Internal MEDIA_EJECT broadcast built as an implicit intent.
AnkiDroid/src/main/java/com/ichi2/anki/receiver/SdCardReceiver.kt:26: Sent with no setPackage or receiver permission.
AnkiDroid/src/main/java/com/ichi2/anki/receiver/SdCardReceiver.kt:37: Internal MEDIA_MOUNT broadcast sent the same way.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0227: Debugging Enabled for WebViews
findings.explanation:
At startup, WebView.setWebContentsDebuggingEnabled is called with a user preference (a developer-options switch shown in release builds), not gated on FLAG_DEBUGGABLE, so release builds can turn on WebView debugging.
AnkiDroid/src/main/java/com/ichi2/anki/AnkiDroidApp.kt:240: WebView debugging enabled from a preference without a FLAG_DEBUGGABLE check.
AnkiDroid/src/main/java/com/ichi2/anki/preferences/DeveloperOptionsFragment.kt:212: The switch is shown only in non-debug (release) builds.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0225: Usage of Insecure APK Signature Key Size
findings.explanation:
The release keystore comes from the KEYSTOREPATH environment at build time, so key size can only be checked on the signed APK. Note that without it, release falls back to a committed test keystore.
AnkiDroid/build.gradle.kts:176: Release signing silently falls back to a keystore committed to the repo when KEYSTOREPATH is unset.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0202: References to APIs and Permissions for Accessing External Storage
findings.explanation:
WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE and MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE are declared and the legacy collection folder is built on Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory(), so the unencrypted collection (user's notes and review history) can live in shared storage on legacy installs. Whether that flashcard data counts as sensitive is the owner's call.
AnkiDroid/src/main/java/com/ichi2/anki/startup/SetupStorage.kt:147: Legacy collection directory is placed in public external storage.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0216: Sensitive Data Not Excluded From Backup
findings.explanation:
